 Job Posting Title: 
 
Application Developer, Business Applications & Process Automation About Us:  
 TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We hope you will consider joining the team and being part of our future.
 
 Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes Magazine, we are proud to live by a strong set of values and strive to "Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time." Guided by our values— Own It, Commit to Excellence, Be Agile, Speak Up, and Better Together. We are a diverse team driven by integrity, accountability, and a commitment to exceptional results. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise-wide goals.
 
 What You Gain:  
 Competitive compensation and benefits program with no waiting period – you’re eligible from your first day!

 401(k) program with 5% employer match and 100% vesting as soon as you enroll.

 Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays).

 Leaders who are invested in supporting your accelerated career growth, plus paid training, tuition reimbursement and a robust educational platform – DevelopU – with more than 10,000 free courses to support you along the way.

 An inclusive working environment where you can build meaningful work relationships with a diverse group of professionals. Take advantage of opportunities to build on our team-oriented culture, such as joining one of our Employee Resource Groups.

 Access to our wellness and employee assistance programs.

 
 Job Description: 
 
 About the Role: 
 
 We are seeking a self-starting Application Developer, Business Applications & Process Automation, based out of our corporate office in Oak Brook, IL. This role will design, build, and continuously evolve enterprise-grade applications across our low-code/no-code and automation platform stack.
 
 While our current stack is anchored in Quickbase — it includes work with tools such as Microsoft Power Automate, SAP Integrations, RPA, AI agents, and whatever platform best fits the next problem. The Developer will also build AI capability into applications and workflows — surfacing intelligent automation, agents, and AI-assisted decisioning where they add real value. The Developer will also use AI coding tools to move faster and take on more than a traditional developer workload would allow.
 
 This is a product ownership role, not a project execution role — the Developer will own their applications as living products with feature roadmaps and release cycles. Success requires the ability to quickly learn new tools and working alongside AI in both directions, as well as the ability to work closely with business stakeholders, acting as a change agent for automation and digital adoption, bringing a strong bias for action to everything you build.
 
 You’ll add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to: 
 
 Product Ownership & Agile Delivery
 Own a product’s roadmap, adoption, iteration cycle, and long-term health beyond initial go-live
 Operate within Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand-ups, and retrospectives; break large initiatives into shippable increments
 Act as a self-starter with a bias for action by proactively identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities, developing solutions, gathering feedback and driving them through to completion with minimal oversight.
 Serve as a change agent, championing automation and digital adoption across teams, influencing stakeholders, and driving process modernization even amid resistance
 
 Technical Development
 Design, develop, maintain, and optimize low-code/no-code business applications, workflow automations, and integrations that improve business processes and enable efficient data exchange across enterprise systems
 Perform data modeling, ETL/data migration, troubleshooting, and system optimization activities to ensure application performance, reliability, and data integrity
 Document technical solutions and continuously expand expertise in emerging platforms, integration methods, and automation technologies to support evolving business needs
 
 AI-Augmented Development
 Leverage AI and automation technologies to enhance business applications and workflows, using sound judgment to apply the most effective technology approach based on business needs, complexity, and risk
 Evaluate and prototype with AI platforms and frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio, LLM APIs, agent frameworks) as part of the broader TreeHouse automation fabric
 Use AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot) to move faster, explore unfamiliar platforms, and take on a heavier workload than manual development alone would support
 
 Important Details:
 This role is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our corporate office in Oak Brook, IL.
 The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $63,500.00 - 95,300.00 USD annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay.
 
 You’ll fit right in if you have:
 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated aptitude and practical experience
 1–4 years of professional experience in application development, scripting, or low-code/no-code platforms — no deep QuickBase background required
 Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: a low-code/no-code platform (QuickBase, Power Apps, Out Systems, Mendix, Airtable, ServiceNow, Appian, etc.), a scripting/programming language, or database and relational data concepts
 Exposure to, or genuine interest in learning, Agile/Scrum or Kanban ways of working
 Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and how systems integrate
 Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to help build, debug, or learn, and to multiply output
 Demonstrated experience working in, or strong interest in, a product ownership capacity (owning solutions end-to-end) rather than purely task/project execution
 Proven track record of taking initiative and driving work independently, even in unfamiliar territory
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
 Good communication skills; comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Experience with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate, Dataverse)
 Familiarity with SQL and database design
 Hands-on SAP integration experience (e.g., data migrations, middleware, or API-based connections)
 Formal Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe) a plus
 Background in business analysis or process improvement (Lean/Six Sigma a plus)
 Prior experience in a citizen-developer or hybrid technical/functional role
 Experience with RPA tools or other automation platforms
 
                                                               
                                                                                                                                             
 Your TreeHouse Foods Career is Just a Click Away! 
 Click on the “Apply” button or go directly to   www.treehousefoods.com/careers   to let us know you’re ready to join our team! 
 
 
 
 At TreeHouse Foods, we embrace diversity and inclusion for innovation and growth. We are committed to building inclusive teams and an equitable workplace for our employees to bring their true selves to work to help us “Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time”.   TreeHouse Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type.
